'''Recon-A''' was a [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] commando squad consisting of ten troopers who were armed with [[Blaster carbine/Legends|blaster carbines]] and [[Repeating blaster/Legends|repeating blasters]]. Under the command of [[Bren Harvist]], they were assigned to help rebuild an [[Unidentified Ewok village (Sector 5-7)|Ewok village]] after the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]]. When the village was [[Skirmish on Endor (Recon-A)|attacked]], Recon-A helped defend it.
